**Test cases the backend runs**

**Test 1: Runs the walkthrough from the instructions** (visible)

```typescript
import { createHandler, loadConfig } from "./solution.js";

// The walkthrough from the instructions: defaults, then one evening of bookings on a 30 kg kiln.

const defaults = loadConfig({});
check.equal(
  { host: defaults.host, port: defaults.port, maxLoadKg: defaults.maxLoadKg },
  { host: "127.0.0.1", port: 8080, maxLoadKg: 60 },
  "loadConfig({}) uses the default host, port and load",
);

const handle = createHandler(loadConfig({ KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "30" }));

check.equal(
  handle({ method: "GET", path: "/health", body: undefined }),
  { status: 200, body: { status: "ok" } },
  "GET /health answers 200 with { status: \"ok\" }",
);

const ines = handle({
  method: "POST",
  path: "/firings",
  body: { member: "  Ines Duarte ", pieces: 6, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" },
});
check.equal(
  ines,
  { status: 201, body: { booking: { id: "B-1", member: "Ines Duarte", pieces: 6, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" } } },
  "the first valid booking is created as B-1 with the member's name trimmed",
);

const tomas = handle({
  method: "POST",
  path: "/firings",
  body: { member: "Tomas", pieces: 4, weightKg: 15, cone: "06" },
});
check.equal(tomas.status, 201, "a second booking that still fits is created");

const full = handle({
  method: "POST",
  path: "/firings",
  body: { member: "Wen", pieces: 2, weightKg: 5, cone: "10" },
});
const fullBody = full.body as { error: { code: string; message: string } };
check.equal(full.status, 409, "a booking that would overload the kiln is refused with 409");
check.equal(fullBody.error.code, "kiln_full", "the refusal carries the code kiln_full");
check.equal(typeof fullBody.error.message, "string", "every error has a message");

const invalid = handle({
  method: "POST",
  path: "/firings",
  body: { member: "Ade", pieces: 0, weightKg: 2, cone: "5" },
});
const invalidBody = invalid.body as { error: { code: string; details: { field: string }[] } };
check.equal(invalid.status, 400, "an invalid booking is refused with 400");
check.equal(invalidBody.error.code, "invalid_body", "the refusal carries the code invalid_body");
check.equal(
  invalidBody.error.details.map((detail) => detail.field),
  ["pieces", "cone"],
  "the details name every field with a problem, in order",
);

check.equal(
  handle({ method: "GET", path: "/firings", body: undefined }),
  {
    status: 200,
    body: {
      bookings: [
        { id: "B-1", member: "Ines Duarte", pieces: 6, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" },
        { id: "B-2", member: "Tomas", pieces: 4, weightKg: 15, cone: "06" },
      ],
      loadKg: 27.5,
      capacityKg: 30,
    },
  },
  "GET /firings lists the accepted bookings with the load and the capacity",
);
```

**Test 2: Reads configuration from the environment and reports every problem** (hidden)

```typescript
import { ConfigError, loadConfig, type Config } from "./solution.js";

function plain(config: Config): { host: string; port: number; maxLoadKg: number } {
  return { host: config.host, port: config.port, maxLoadKg: config.maxLoadKg };
}

function problemsOf(env: Record<string, string | undefined>, what: string): readonly string[] {
  const error = check.throws(() => loadConfig(env), `loadConfig refuses ${what}`, ConfigError);
  return (error as ConfigError).problems;
}

function variablesIn(problems: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return problems.map((problem) => problem.split(" ")[0] ?? "");
}

check.equal(
  plain(loadConfig({ KILN_HOST: " 0.0.0.0 ", KILN_PORT: " 9090 ", KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "72.5" })),
  { host: "0.0.0.0", port: 9090, maxLoadKg: 72.5 },
  "set variables are trimmed and parsed",
);
check.equal(plain(loadConfig({ KILN_PORT: "0" })).port, 0, "KILN_PORT may be 0, meaning any free port");
check.equal(plain(loadConfig({ KILN_PORT: "65535" })).port, 65535, "KILN_PORT may be 65535");
check.equal(plain(loadConfig({ KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "500" })).maxLoadKg, 500, "KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG may be 500");
check.equal(
  plain(loadConfig({ KILN_PORT: undefined, UNRELATED: "x" })),
  { host: "127.0.0.1", port: 8080, maxLoadKg: 60 },
  "variables that are not set, and unrelated ones, leave the defaults",
);
check.true(Object.isFrozen(loadConfig({})), "the configuration object is frozen");

for (const bad of ["", "eighty", "1e3", "80.5", "-1", "65536", "8 080"]) {
  check.equal(
    variablesIn(problemsOf({ KILN_PORT: bad }, `KILN_PORT="${bad}"`)),
    ["KILN_PORT"],
    `KILN_PORT="${bad}" is reported as one problem naming the variable`,
  );
}
for (const bad of ["", "0", "-5", "abc", "500.5", "1e2", "12kg"]) {
  check.equal(
    variablesIn(problemsOf({ KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: bad }, `KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG="${bad}"`)),
    ["KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG"],
    `KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG="${bad}" is reported as one problem naming the variable`,
  );
}
check.equal(
  variablesIn(problemsOf({ KILN_HOST: "   " }, "a blank KILN_HOST")),
  ["KILN_HOST"],
  "a blank KILN_HOST is reported",
);
check.equal(
  variablesIn(problemsOf({ KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "lots", KILN_PORT: "http", KILN_HOST: "" }, "three bad variables")),
  ["KILN_HOST", "KILN_PORT", "KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG"],
  "every problem is reported at once, in the order host, port, load",
);
check.true(new ConfigError(["KILN_PORT x"]) instanceof Error, "ConfigError is an Error");

// Type checks only: this function is compiled, never called.
export function typesOnly(config: Config): void {
  // @ts-expect-error the configuration is read-only
  config.port = 1;
}
```

**Test 3: Validates booking bodies field by field, with exact types** (hidden)

```typescript
import { validateBooking, type Cone, type ValidationResult } from "./solution.js";

const good = { member: "Ines", pieces: 6, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" };

function fieldsOf(body: unknown, what: string): string[] {
  const result = validateBooking(body);
  if (result.ok) fail(`validateBooking refuses ${what}`);
  return result.problems.map((problem) => problem.field);
}

const accepted = validateBooking({ ...good, member: "\tIrena Novak  " });
check.equal(
  accepted,
  { ok: true, booking: { member: "Irena Novak", pieces: 6, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" } },
  "a valid body is accepted with the member's name trimmed",
);

for (const body of [null, undefined, [good], "Ines", 42]) {
  check.equal(fieldsOf(body, `the body ${JSON.stringify(body)}`), ["body"], "a body that is not a JSON object is one problem on \"body\"");
}

check.equal(fieldsOf({}, "an empty object"), ["member", "pieces", "weightKg", "cone"], "an empty object misses all four fields, in order");

const badMembers: unknown[] = ["", "   ", "x".repeat(41), 7, null];
for (const member of badMembers) {
  check.equal(fieldsOf({ ...good, member }, `member ${JSON.stringify(member)}`), ["member"], "member must be a name of 1 to 40 characters");
}
check.equal(validateBooking({ ...good, member: "x".repeat(40) }).ok, true, "a member name of exactly 40 characters is allowed");

const badPieces: unknown[] = [0, 21, 2.5, "6", Number.NaN];
for (const pieces of badPieces) {
  check.equal(fieldsOf({ ...good, pieces }, `pieces ${String(pieces)}`), ["pieces"], "pieces must be a whole number from 1 to 20");
}
check.equal(validateBooking({ ...good, pieces: 1 }).ok && validateBooking({ ...good, pieces: 20 }).ok, true, "1 and 20 pieces are allowed");

const badWeights: unknown[] = [0, -1, 25.5, "12", Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NaN];
for (const weightKg of badWeights) {
  check.equal(fieldsOf({ ...good, weightKg }, `weightKg ${String(weightKg)}`), ["weightKg"], "weightKg must be above 0 and at most 25");
}
check.equal(validateBooking({ ...good, weightKg: 25 }).ok && validateBooking({ ...good, weightKg: 0.25 }).ok, true, "25 kg and 0.25 kg are allowed");

const badCones: unknown[] = ["5", "6 ", 6, "Cone 6", "006", null];
for (const cone of badCones) {
  check.equal(fieldsOf({ ...good, cone }, `cone ${JSON.stringify(cone)}`), ["cone"], "cone must be exactly one of the four cone strings");
}
for (const cone of ["06", "04", "6", "10"]) {
  check.equal(validateBooking({ ...good, cone }).ok, true, `cone "${cone}" is allowed`);
}

check.equal(
  fieldsOf({ glaze: "celadon", ...good, pieces: 99, paid: true }, "unknown fields"),
  ["pieces", "glaze", "paid"],
  "unknown fields are problems too, after the known fields, in the order they appear",
);

// Type checks only: this function is compiled, never called.
export function typesOnly(result: ValidationResult): Cone {
  // @ts-expect-error "5" is not a cone
  const wrong: Cone = "5";
  // @ts-expect-error the booking is only there once ok has been checked
  const unchecked = result.booking;
  void wrong;
  void unchecked;
  if (!result.ok) {
    // @ts-expect-error a failed result has no booking
    return result.booking.cone;
  }
  return result.booking.cone;
}
```

**Test 4: Routes every request and answers with structured errors** (hidden)

```typescript
import { createHandler, errorResponse, loadConfig, type ApiResponse, type ErrorCode } from "./solution.js";

interface ErrorBody {
  error: { code: string; message: string; details?: unknown };
}

function codeOf(response: ApiResponse): string {
  return (response.body as ErrorBody).error.code;
}

check.equal(
  errorResponse(404, "not_found", "nothing at /kilns"),
  { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "nothing at /kilns" } } },
  "errorResponse without details has no details property",
);
check.equal(
  errorResponse(400, "invalid_body", "bad", [{ field: "cone", problem: "unknown cone" }]),
  { status: 400, body: { error: { code: "invalid_body", message: "bad", details: [{ field: "cone", problem: "unknown cone" }] } } },
  "errorResponse with details includes them",
);

const handle = createHandler(loadConfig({ KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "20" }));
const post = (body: unknown): ApiResponse => handle({ method: "POST", path: "/firings", body });

for (const [method, path, status, code] of [
  ["GET", "/kilns", 404, "not_found"],
  ["GET", "/firings/", 404, "not_found"],
  ["GET", "/Firings", 404, "not_found"],
  ["GET", "/", 404, "not_found"],
  ["DELETE", "/firings", 405, "method_not_allowed"],
  ["PUT", "/firings", 405, "method_not_allowed"],
  ["POST", "/health", 405, "method_not_allowed"],
] as const) {
  const response = handle({ method, path, body: undefined });
  check.equal([response.status, codeOf(response)], [status, code], `${method} ${path} is answered with ${status}`);
}

const invalid = post({ member: "Ade", pieces: 3, weightKg: 1, cone: "6", price: 0 });
check.equal(invalid.status, 400, "a body with an unknown field is refused with 400");
const details = (invalid.body as ErrorBody).error.details as Record<string, unknown>[];
check.equal(
  details.map((detail) => [Object.keys(detail).sort(), detail["field"], typeof detail["problem"]]),
  [[["field", "problem"], "price", "string"]],
  "the details of an invalid body are the problems, as { field, problem } objects",
);
check.equal(codeOf(post("not an object")), "invalid_body", "a body that is not an object is invalid_body");

check.equal(post({ member: "Ade", pieces: 3, weightKg: 12.5, cone: "6" }).status, 201, "12.5 kg fits in a 20 kg kiln");
const tooMuch = post({ member: "Bo", pieces: 3, weightKg: 7.75, cone: "04" });
check.equal([tooMuch.status, codeOf(tooMuch)], [409, "kiln_full"], "7.75 kg more would be 20.25 kg, over capacity");
const exact = post({ member: "Bo", pieces: 3, weightKg: 7.5, cone: "04" });
check.equal(exact.status, 201, "a booking that fills the kiln exactly is accepted");
check.equal(
  (exact.body as { booking: { id: string } }).booking.id,
  "B-2",
  "refused bookings do not use up an id",
);
const nothingLeft = post({ member: "Cy", pieces: 1, weightKg: 0.25, cone: "10" });
check.equal(codeOf(nothingLeft), "kiln_full", "a full kiln refuses even the smallest booking");

const listing = handle({ method: "GET", path: "/firings", body: { ignored: true } }).body as {
  bookings: { id: string }[];
  loadKg: number;
  capacityKg: number;
};
check.equal(
  [listing.bookings.map((booking) => booking.id), listing.loadKg, listing.capacityKg],
  [["B-1", "B-2"], 20, 20],
  "GET /firings shows only the accepted bookings and the full load",
);

const other = createHandler(loadConfig({}));
const fresh = other({ method: "GET", path: "/firings", body: undefined }).body as { bookings: unknown[]; capacityKg: number };
check.equal([fresh.bookings.length, fresh.capacityKg], [0, 60], "each handler keeps its own bookings");
check.equal(
  (other({ method: "POST", path: "/firings", body: { member: "Di", pieces: 1, weightKg: 1, cone: "6" } }).body as { booking: { id: string } }).booking.id,
  "B-1",
  "each handler numbers its own bookings from B-1",
);

// Type checks only: this function is compiled, never called.
export function typesOnly(): ErrorCode {
  // @ts-expect-error "teapot" is not an error code
  errorResponse(418, "teapot", "short and stout");
  // @ts-expect-error error codes are exact strings
  const loose: ErrorCode = "Not_Found";
  return loose;
}
```

**Test 5: Serves JSON on 127.0.0.1 and shuts down gracefully** (hidden)

```typescript
import { MAX_BODY_BYTES, loadConfig, startServer, type Handler, type RunningServer } from "./solution.js";

const config = loadConfig({ KILN_PORT: "0", KILN_MAX_LOAD_KG: "20" });

async function call(server: RunningServer, method: string, path: string, body?: string): Promise<{ status: number; type: string; text: string }> {
  const response = await fetch(server.url + path, body === undefined ? { method } : { method, body });
  return { status: response.status, type: response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "", text: await response.text() };
}

function json(text: string, what: string): unknown {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return fail(`${what}: the response body is JSON`);
  }
}

function codeIn(text: string, what: string): unknown {
  return (json(text, what) as { error?: { code?: unknown } }).error?.code;
}

// 1. The real handler behind a real server on 127.0.0.1.
const server = await startServer(config);
try {
  check.true(/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:\d+$/.test(server.url), "url is http://127.0.0.1:<port>");
  check.true(!server.url.endsWith(":0"), "url names the port the server actually listens on, not 0");

  const health = await call(server, "GET", "/health");
  check.equal([health.status, json(health.text, "GET /health")], [200, { status: "ok" }], "GET /health over HTTP");
  check.true(health.type.startsWith("application/json"), "responses are sent as application/json");

  const created = await call(server, "POST", "/firings", JSON.stringify({ member: "Ines", pieces: 2, weightKg: 4, cone: "6" }));
  check.equal(
    [created.status, json(created.text, "POST /firings")],
    [201, { booking: { id: "B-1", member: "Ines", pieces: 2, weightKg: 4, cone: "6" } }],
    "POST /firings with a JSON body creates a booking",
  );

  const listed = await call(server, "GET", "/firings?week=42");
  check.equal(
    (json(listed.text, "GET /firings") as { bookings: unknown[] }).bookings.length,
    1,
    "the query string is not part of the path",
  );

  const broken = await call(server, "POST", "/firings", "{ member: Ines");
  check.equal([broken.status, codeIn(broken.text, "malformed JSON")], [400, "invalid_json"], "malformed JSON is answered with 400 invalid_json");

  const empty = await call(server, "POST", "/firings", "");
  check.equal([empty.status, codeIn(empty.text, "an empty body")], [400, "invalid_body"], "an empty body reaches the handler as undefined");

  const huge = await call(server, "POST", "/firings", "x".repeat(MAX_BODY_BYTES + 1));
  check.equal([huge.status, codeIn(huge.text, "a huge body")], [413, "payload_too_large"], "a body over MAX_BODY_BYTES is answered with 413");

  const padding = MAX_BODY_BYTES - JSON.stringify({ note: "" }).length;
  const atLimit = await call(server, "POST", "/firings", JSON.stringify({ note: "y".repeat(padding) }));
  check.equal(atLimit.status, 400, "a body of exactly MAX_BODY_BYTES bytes is still read");

  const missing = await call(server, "GET", "/kilns");
  check.equal([missing.status, codeIn(missing.text, "an unknown path")], [404, "not_found"], "unknown paths are answered with 404 over HTTP");
} finally {
  await server.close();
}

// 2. A handler that fails: a generic 500, nothing leaked, the server keeps serving.
let calls = 0;
const failing: Handler = async (request) => {
  calls += 1;
  if (request.path === "/boom") throw new Error("kiln controller password is hunter2");
  if (request.path === "/reject") return Promise.reject(new Error("hunter2 again"));
  return { status: 200, body: { path: request.path } };
};
const fragile = await startServer(config, failing);
try {
  for (const path of ["/boom", "/reject"]) {
    const crashed = await call(fragile, "GET", path);
    check.equal([crashed.status, codeIn(crashed.text, "a failing handler")], [500, "internal"], "a handler that throws or rejects gives 500 internal");
    check.true(!crashed.text.includes("hunter2"), "the 500 response does not reveal the error's message");
  }
  const after = await call(fragile, "GET", "/still-here");
  check.equal(after.status, 200, "the server keeps serving after a handler fails");
  calls = 0;
  await call(fragile, "POST", "/x", "{ nope");
  await call(fragile, "POST", "/x", "z".repeat(MAX_BODY_BYTES + 10));
  check.equal(calls, 0, "the handler is not called for malformed or oversized bodies");
} finally {
  await fragile.close();
}

// 3. Graceful shutdown: wait for the request in flight, refuse new ones, then finish promptly.
const entered = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
const release = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
const slow = await startServer(config, async (request) => {
  entered.resolve();
  await release.promise;
  return { status: 200, body: { done: request.path } };
});
const inFlight = fetch(`${slow.url}/firings`).then(
  async (response) => [response.status, await response.json()],
  () => "cut off",
);
await entered.promise;

let closed = false;
const closing = slow.close().then(() => {
  closed = true;
});
await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
check.true(!closed, "close() waits for the request in flight");
await check.rejects(() => fetch(`${slow.url}/health`), "a new connection after close() is refused");

release.resolve();
const answered = await inFlight;
check.true(answered !== "cut off", "the request in flight is answered, not cut off");
check.equal(answered, [200, { done: "/firings" }], "the request in flight gets its full response");

const outcome = await Promise.race([
  closing.then(() => "closed"),
  new Promise<string>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve("still open"), 1000).unref()),
]);
check.equal(outcome, "closed", "close() finishes promptly once the last request is answered, even over a keep-alive connection");
```
